interface.name: com.canonical.AppMenu.Registrar
interface.dox:d: An interface to register a menu from an application's window to be displayed in another window. This compatibility interface treats the numeric ID as an opaque registration token and associates it with the dbus address and object that provides the menu using the dbusmenu dbus interface.

method.name: RegisterWindow
method.dox:d:
Associates a dbusmenu with a window
/note this method assumes that the connection from the caller is the DBus connection to use for the object. Applications that use multiple DBus connections will need to ensure this method is called with the same connection that implmenets the object.

arg.name: windowId
arg.dox:d: An opaque registration token supplied by the application

arg.name: menuObjectPath
arg.dox:d: The object on the dbus interface implementing the dbusmenu interface

method.name: UnregisterWindow
method.dox:d: A method to allow removing a window from the database. Windows will also be removed when the client drops off DBus so this is not required. It is polite though. And important for testing.

method.name: GetMenuForWindow
method.dox:d: Gets the registered menu for a given window ID.

arg.name: windowId
arg.dox:d: The opaque registration token to query

arg.name: service
arg.dox:d: The address of the connection on DBus (e.g. :1.23 or org.example.service)

arg.name: menuObjectPath
arg.dox:d: The path to the object which implements the com.canonical.dbusmenu interface.
